title: Profile manifest (several source images)
$comment: v1 (MS-2, decision 179), manifest schema_version 2. Differs from profile_manifest.v0 only in the renderer block: image_reference_syntax is gone (unknown key here) and max_source_images, source_image_syntax and reference_image_syntax are added. The drafter may answer null for the three it cannot read from the prompt (as v0 did for image_reference_syntax); the loader refuses null, so the admin states the value before the profile loads. Value rules live in code, not here (R-015, AGENTS.md section 5): max_source_images is a positive exact integer; each syntax is the string none or a string with exactly one {n} and no other brace; the two syntaxes never render a string that equals or contains another for n from 1 to the cap; none needs max_source_images of 1; a non-none reference syntax needs accepts_reference_images true. The schema writes no minimum, pattern or maxItems so it can also be sent as a structured-output schema.

meta.$comment: Loader metadata of the [META] section (sectioned format only); mapped to a runtime parameter only when the backend supports it.

template_values.description: Admin-confirmed fixed values for template variables other than the input variable (decision 81)

max_source_images.description: How many source images the image model accepts in one edit; a positive integer (checked by the loader), null only in an unconfirmed draft.

source_image_syntax.description: The string none, or the prompt's syntax for one source image with exactly one {n}; null only in an unconfirmed draft.

reference_image_syntax.description: The same for one knowledge-base reference image; each group counts from 1.

validator.description: Named structural checks the profile declares for its output; an empty list means only the generic checks run.

config_keys.description: Dotted configuration keys the rule conflicts with; empty when it conflicts with a fixed pipeline rule. config_wins requires at least one.
